- Codex allowance rim and reset countdown, plus working, needs-input, and done
  states with alert sounds for needs-input and done.
- Weather and allowance readings remain visible while useful, with their age
  available on tap. The desktop panel reports weather failures separately and
  offers retry when needed.
- Lower idle power use.

Update both the desktop client and watch firmware. Allowance comes from
Omarchy's agents panel. Codex status and alerts require the optional
[Omarchy Watch for Codex v0.2.0](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch-codex/releases/tag/v0.2.0)
companion. After updating the companion, start a new Codex session and review
the changed hooks with `/hooks`.

The flash bundle preserves pairing and settings. See the
[update guide](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch#update).
